in_marathi.name: Prithivi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Earth, Goddess of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prithivi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prithivi is the Sanskrit name of the Hindu goddess of the earth. She is the wife of Vishnu and the mother of the gods. She is also known as Pritha, Pritha Devi, and Aditi. Prithivi is often depicted as a beautiful, voluptuous woman with many arms, holding a plough, a lotus, or a trident.
